expectation: A backgrounded 'adb logcat -s ... > file' grows in real time and a driver loop can grep markers from it as they are logged

Fix: pump the stream through 'while IFS= read -r line' appending per line (line-buffered); the plain redirection in run-spike-e2e.sh only works because its completion tag lands in an already-flushed chunk.
